csv_agency: County of Ventura Department of Airports
csv_scope_of_work: The Ventura County Department of Airports (County) owns and operates two public-use general aviation airports: Camarillo Airport (CMA) and Oxnard Airport (OXR). The County is responsible for maintaining, improving, and expanding infrastructure at both airports to support safe and efficient operations and to meet applicable regulatory requirements. The County regularly undertakes planning and environmental studies to support capital development, FAA grant program requirements, noise compatibility, land use compatibility, and long-term airport development at both airports.
